entry.title: structured data in practice
entry.content:
Every few months structured data bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Structured data shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: rethinking structured data
entry.content:
A quick write-up on structured data, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Structured data shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
